services.name: Private Sessions
services.desc: Fitness looks different for everyone. You can meet your personal goals at your own pace with Gold Line Pilates' custom Pilates programs at our studios in South Pasadena & Pasadena, CA. You'll be placed with one of our professional instructors for one-on-one instruction and coaching. We'll discuss your goals and timeline with you ahead of time so we can arrange a plan that matches your experience and pushes you toward your objective. Feel free to get in touch with us to learn more about our private Pilates sessions. At Gold Line Pilates, we understand that everyone has different strengths and goals.
